scope: Quadratic Ad-invariant gauge kinetic forms on the full split simple Lie algebra so(7,7), with maximal-compact and Cartan-majorant controls; not a theorem about a source-selected physical quotient or a field-dependent symmetry-breaking mechanism.

cartan_signature.split_part: p consists of the 7x7 opposite-sign boosts, dimension 49
cartan_signature.trace_form: up to a positive scalar the Killing form is Tr(XY)
cartan_signature.signature: (49 positive,42 negative), up to overall reversal

invariant_form_theorem.classification: because so(7,7) is real split simple, every invariant symmetric bilinear form is a real scalar multiple of its Killing form
invariant_form_theorem.nonzero_case: every nonzero invariant form is indefinite
invariant_form_theorem.conclusion: no positive-definite Ad(G)-invariant quadratic gauge kinetic form exists on the full split algebra

positive_controls.maximal_compact: -B restricted to k is positive definite
positive_controls.cartan_majorant: B_theta(X,Y)=-B(X,theta Y) is positive after choosing a Cartan involution theta
positive_controls.ownership_boundary: choosing k or theta is extra reduction/selector data; it is not supplied by full-G invariance alone and must be compatible with the actual local gauge action and observation map

claim_ceiling: A conventional quadratic gauge kinetic term cannot be both positive definite and invariant under the full local split Spin_0(7,7) adjoint action. Positivity is restored on a chosen maximal compact algebra or by a chosen Cartan majorant, but that choice is precisely additional reduction/observation data and does not resolve SC-META-53 by itself.
